content:
The CEO of OpenAI is Sam Altman. He co-founded the organization and has led it through the development and release of the GPT series of models and ChatGPT.

Note: There was a brief period in November 2023 when Altman was temporarily removed from the position but was reinstated shortly after. As of my knowledge cutoff, he remains CEO.
